intervention: none; observer only, no extra RNG
anchor: actual outcome event clock in both real and simulated games; made FG with and-one anchors only at final regular FT made or subsequent rebound
first: next FG attempt, turnover, ordinary defensive foul, regular FT, or possession-ending defensive rebound; period end censored
segment: next retained-ball anchor (OREB or nonshooting foul without same-clock regular FT), or possession end; excludes period-censored cases from means
full: from anchor through repeated OREB and fouls until made FG without and-one, final regular FT made, DREB, turnover, opponent activity; overlapping tails descriptive, never sum as total game time
exclusions: special FTs/fouls, nonfinal FT rebounds, missing or inconsistent rebound shot reference; unknown opponent event aborts full tail; missing games listed
clock: game-clock seconds, not wall-clock stoppage time; negative time rejected
statistics: per-state mean median P90 frequency; matched available official games; 20,000 franchise+seed paired bootstrap with cross-season shared resampling; 3 diagnostic seeds, not adoption test
decomposition: first-event pooled mean difference = real frequency-weighted within-state difference plus composition difference weighted by simulated means; not causal total-game decomposition
parity: all simulated matches scores, teams and players must exactly match frozen calibrated run with same seed
stop: diagnosis only; no clock recalibration or mechanism repair
